members.title: Members
members.permission_hint: Only the owner can generate/revoke invite codes, remove members, rename the ledger or change its base currency, transfer ownership, or delete the ledger; members can record and edit transactions, manage accounts, import, and undo imports.
members.remove_confirm: Remove {{name}}? Their entries will stay in the ledger.
members.transfer_confirm: Transfer ownership to {{name}}? You'll become a member afterward.
members.leave_disabled_hint: You're the owner of this ledger — transfer ownership to someone else before you leave

invite.title: Invite code
invite.hint: Tell the other person this 6-digit code so they can enter it under "Join a ledger." It's used up after one person joins.
invite.revoke_confirm: Once revoked, this code stops working immediately.
invite.expires_hint: A code is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once.
invite.retry_hint: The code can be entered as often as needed while it is valid - a typo locks nothing.
invite.expired: This code has expired - generate a new one
